## Climate Snapshot for 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-07

This dataset compares **average temperature** and **rainfall** across five cities in one week. For a Grade 10 project, the clearest pair is a **bar chart for temperature** and a **bar chart for rainfall**.

## Two Simple Charts to Use

### Chart 1: Average Temperature by City
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/thermometer-half.svg

- **Chart type:** Vertical bar chart
- **What it should show:** City names on the x-axis, **AvgTempC** on the y-axis
- **Best use:** Easy comparison of which city was warmest or coolest
- **Expected pattern:** Cairo and São Paulo are warmest; Helsinki is much colder than the others

### Chart 2: Rainfall by City
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg

- **Chart type:** Vertical bar chart
- **What it should show:** City names on the x-axis, **RainMm** on the y-axis
- **Best use:** Shows which city was driest or wettest
- **Expected pattern:** São Paulo has the most rain; Cairo has none

## City Comparison for Your Charts

| City | AvgTempC | RainMm | What it suggests |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Cairo | 24 | 0 | Hot and very dry |
| Nairobi | 21 | 18 | Mild warmth with some rain |
| Helsinki | 4 | 9 | Cold and relatively dry |
| São Paulo | 22 | 52 | Warm and very wet |
| Sydney | 19 | 14 | Mild temperature with moderate rain |

## Three Key Insights to Present

- **Temperature varies a lot more than rainfall in some cities:** Helsinki is far colder than the others, while Cairo is the warmest.
- **Rainfall is very uneven:** São Paulo is the wettest city by a wide margin, while Cairo has **0 mm**.
- **Warm does not always mean dry:** São Paulo is warm, but it also has the highest rainfall, showing that climate is not determined by temperature alone.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Make Rainfall Chart] https://www.google.com/search?q=bar+chart+rainfall+city+data
